name: thoughtdome
title: thunderdome of thought
blurb: two rival definitions of a contested idea enter the ring — folk intuition vs. neuroscience vs. philosophy on THINKING, plus ten more concepts (consciousness, free will, meaning, truth, art, and more). you pick the winner every round, king-of-the-hill, and an ELO board keeps score. @eugenevinitsky.bsky.social distinguished thinking (folk) from thinking (neuroscience) from thinking (philosophy) so the internet could fight about it all day; @feileacan.net asked where the thunderdome of thought was when you needed it. now there's one.
